scope: Independent source-only semantic review of the actual short-cycle phase and residual path classification; not full-paper/lightness/runtime completion or remote CI
semantic_checks: WeightedPathSplit accounts for the shared endpoint exactly once. The first-threshold split is an actual decomposition of the given simple walk, and its mass bounds have the required directions.

CoarsePathDetourGap lifts the actual middle path inside A sup T. Every lifted edge is strictly lighter than the designated original heavy edge, so that edge cannot occur. The existing replacement-walk theorem extracts a real simple cycle after bypass, and nonnegative host weights justify the bypass inequality. The resulting strict gap is (g-1)w(e)+1 < effective path mass.

PathRootedWalk includes only original supported host walks. Effective mass d+1 pays each genuine unit connector; the radial bound subtracts one once. No shortest-path or projected-distance oracle is assumed.

ShortCycleWalks balances the middle and forms two rooted branch unions, whose union is exactly the selected three-piece carrier. The original heavy edge is crossed at most once. The diameter certificate is the actual edge-dependent value 2(L+2D+1)+w(e).

ShortCycleArms counts both shared centers once. Its connected carrier gives card(S)-1 actual internal coarse edges; the two long outer arms and the middle detour gap imply the surplus delta=(g-2)ell-6D-4 beyond the edge-dependent diameter, using g>=2 and ell<=w(e).

BoundedSurplusPayment correctly splits on card(S)<=N. The small case uses a*N+cb/2<=c*delta; the large case uses baseline credit for every old cluster and 2a<=cb. No bound on the selected carrier size is supplied as a premise.
Threshold trimming constructs actual contiguous outer subpaths, preserves the middle path and original heavy edge, and proves carrier containment in the original simple path.

ShortCycleCore eligibility contains original walk geometry and an actual B edge, not the desired credit/payment inequality. Its paid theorem derives that inequality from weighted girth plus explicit numerical and old-credit assumptions.
ShortCycleCorePacking maximizes over a finite family of genuine eligible carriers. The proof uses nonempty carriers to augment the maximum, and permits the empty packing when no core exists.

WeightedShortCyclePhase retains each selected edge-dependent radius in its payment inequality. The uniform family diameter is a separate upper bound; the paid radius is not silently enlarged to that bound.

Full old-family coverage makes every original incident heavy edge belong to touchingEdges. Weighted girth derives absence of heavy loops and uniqueness of heavy fibers; the degree bound then pays all incident edges. One fixed original connector embedding gives distinct unit edges for disjoint selected carriers.

SeparatedPathPieces derives a nonempty middle gap from the strict long-middle mass bound. Simplicity of the whole path, rather than an assumed separation oracle, proves the two outside supports disjoint, including the endpoint-equality cases.

SamePathCoreDichotomy uses the short-middle case to construct a short-cycle core and the long-middle case to construct two genuine disjoint four-arm carriers. All selected vertices stay in the original path.

PathCoreResidual selects the short-cycle maximum first and a four-arm maximum in its actual complement, proving cross-family disjointness. Its near-end conclusions follow from the resulting no-core invariant on actual residual paths.
explicit_boundaries: Old cluster coverage, intrinsic diameter certificates, per-cluster credit/baseline, unit connectors, low coarse degree, weighted girth/light-heavy separation and numerical scale conditions remain explicit input invariants.

The short-cycle numerical conditions are a*N+cb/2<=c*((g-2)ell-6D-4), 2c*(2(L+2D+1)+M)+cb<=N*cb, 2a<=cb, where a=qM; the no-loop/no-parallel join also requires 2D<=(g-2)ell. A simultaneous global parameter choice is not proved here.

The residual exclusion concerns far-to-far edges on a supplied residual simple path or between disjoint residual simple paths. Endpoint absorption, small components, deferred edges and a covering next-level family remain to be joined.
The paid short-cycle phase and joint residual partition are proved components. This packet does not yet assert a full paid hierarchy, global multilevel lightness or runtime.

No compiler or kernel replay was run by this reviewer. Owner strict builds/replays and exhaustive audit are separate evidence. The reviewed local gate receipt SHA is recorded; independent remote-byte binding remains required after publication.
